title: Authorization gate for weak permission control
content: Enforce authorization before a protected operation is executed. The control must inspect the current permission state and deny the operation when permission is denied. This control directly mitigates weak_permission_control by enforcing authorization before tool execution.
validation: Replay the same permission attack and verify that a denied permission produces a denied operation and the protected tool is not executed.

title: Tool allowlist for unsafe tool exposure
content: Restrict agent tool exposure to an explicit allowlist. A registered or available tool must not be callable unless it is present in the approved allowlist for the current agent context. This control directly mitigates unsafe_tool_access.
validation: Replay the same tool-access attack and verify that a restricted tool is unavailable or rejected before execution.

title: Memory validation boundary
content: Validate memory data before accepting it as trusted agent state. Untrusted, malformed, or instruction-like memory content must not automatically become trusted state. This control directly mitigates memory_validation_weakness.
validation: Replay the same memory attack and verify that unvalidated memory is rejected or marked untrusted and cannot be consumed as trusted state.

title: Authorization and least privilege
content: Sensitive operations should require an authorization decision and the agent should operate with minimum required permissions.
validation: Repeat the relevant access attempt and confirm the authorization decision is enforced.

title: Explicit tool exposure boundary
content: Tool availability must be determined by an explicit security policy rather than by registration alone. Keep the set of exposed tools limited to the intended task.
validation: Repeat the same tool exposure test and compare the available tool set before and after mitigation.

title: Untrusted memory handling
content: Treat memory retrieved from untrusted sources according to its trust level. Require validation at the memory boundary before the data can influence agent state or instructions.
validation: Replay the same memory input and verify validation occurs before acceptance.

title: Evidence-driven authorization mitigation
content: A permission-related finding should be mitigated with an authorization gate rather than by changing unrelated tool or memory behavior.
validation: Use the same attack input and confirm the authorization failure is enforced.

title: Evidence-driven tool mitigation
content: A finding that a restricted tool is exposed should be mitigated by an explicit tool allowlist. Applying an unrelated control does not establish successful mitigation.
validation: Replay the same attack and verify restricted tool exposure is removed.

title: Evidence-driven memory mitigation
content: A memory validation weakness should be addressed at the memory trust boundary. An unrelated authorization or tool control is not sufficient evidence of mitigation.
validation: Replay the same attack and verify unvalidated memory is not accepted as trusted.
